metadata.description: Personal Claude Code plugins: LSP servers (uvx/npx) and custom agents

plugins.name: vertex-log-monitor
plugins.description: Surfaces whether Vertex AI request/response (prompt+output) logging or Data Access audit logging is enabled for the Claude Code project; refreshes a cache on SessionStart and exposes a status reader for a shell prompt or slash command. Zero-config from ANTHROPIC_*/CLOUD_ML_REGION env.

plugins.name: pyright-uvx
plugins.description: Python language server (via uvx - always latest)

plugins.name: vtsls-npx
plugins.description: TypeScript/JavaScript language server (via npx - always latest)

plugins.name: gopls-go
plugins.description: Go language server (requires gopls on PATH)

plugins.name: vscode-html-css-npx
plugins.description: HTML/CSS language servers (via npx - always latest)

plugins.name: rust-analyzer-rustup
plugins.description: Rust language server (requires rust-analyzer via rustup)

plugins.name: dev-guard
plugins.description: Development environment policy enforcement: tool selection guard, commit validation, URL fetch guard, trust management, oc/kubectl introspection, subagent completion verification, decision persistence, anti-deferral enforcement, shared behavioral feedback, path hallucination guard, narrative comment guard, token efficiency guidance

plugins.name: code-quality
plugins.description: Code quality agents, development utilities, and orchestration skills: architecture, security, QA, performance, test execution, code review, code simplification, plan adherence, LSP navigation, uv-python, incremental planning (with issue tracking and PR boundary markers), roadmap lifecycle management, session management, deep-research (with Bridged mode), business-panel, file-audit, bug-investigation, unfuck, swarm, quality-gate, pr-review, plan-review, map-reduce, speculative, reflect, fix, index-repo, summarize, and test-plan

plugins.name: git-tools
plugins.description: Git workflow tools: dynamic SessionStart git instructions, history manipulation, commit review, and CONTRIBUTING.md generation

plugins.name: github-mcp
plugins.description: GitHub MCP server with full toolsets for repository management, code security, and workflow automation

plugins.name: jira
plugins.description: Jira integration for issue tracking, querying, and management — OSAC defaults with full redhat.atlassian.net support

plugins.name: drawio
plugins.description: Draw.io diagram generation skill — creates native .drawio files with optional PNG/SVG/PDF export via draw.io Desktop CLI. Vendored from jgraph/drawio-mcp (Apache 2.0).

plugins.name: fetchaller-mcp
plugins.description: Pinned MCP fetch/search server for domains that block Claude's built-in WebFetch/WebSearch (Reddit and 15 other sites)

plugins.name: chai-bot
plugins.description: Advisory nudge and explicit /chai-bot command for offloading OSAC-scoped research/actions to the Red Hat-internal Chai Bot MCP server
